note: The farmer who keeps the stable, which is a different job and looks it.

The hat is the farmer's turned up at the sides and given a taller crown, so the two read as the same trade in different weather rather than as two unrelated people. A rolled brim is what separates a man who works a field from a man who works a horse.

parts.note: the brim, narrower than a field hand's and turned up at each side rather than flat
and a taller crown than a field hat, which is the whole difference at a distance
the kerchief at the throat: the one spot of colour, and it reads from directly above
